We are hiring at deepset, makers of Haystack | Forward Deployed Engineers | Remote (EU/UK) + hubs: Berlin, Barcelona, London | Full Time

* We build AI that companies actually run in production (not demos) * You ship customer-facing LLM apps end-to-end: discovery → build → rollout * You sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer teams

Interesting problems you’ll work on: * Turning messy workflows + data into reliable RAG/agent systems * Making prototypes production-ready (latency, evals, reliability, security) * Building repeatable solutions that scale across customers

All roles are here: https://www.deepset.ai/careers Or reach out directly: https://bit.ly/juliaLN
